text_block_list.text:
Cheers ring out for Нарита Брайан as she
defeats the
Assassin and wins the spring
Tenno Sho. Rice
Shower, amidst the
cheers for her foe, stands
proud despite
the loss.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Once again, Нарита Брайан is moved by
Rice
Shower's strength of heart and vows
to get even
stronger.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In order to reach the top, Нарита Брайан
focuses on
the first race of the Senior
Autumn Triple
Crown—the autumn
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
